items.exampleEn: The teacher gives a speech on the first day.
items.exampleZh: 老師在第一天發表演說。

items.exampleEn: We have a long conversation on the phone.
items.exampleZh: 我們在電話裡聊了很久。

items.exampleEn: We did a survey of fifty students.
items.exampleZh: 我們對五十個學生做了調查。

items.exampleEn: This book has many young readers.
items.exampleZh: 這本書有很多年輕讀者。
今天的課是關於動物的。

items.exampleEn: We have a review lesson before the test.
items.exampleZh: 考試前我們上一堂複習課。

items.sentenceEn: The writer gives a speech at our school.
items.sentenceZh: 那位作家到我們學校演講。

items.audioEn: Today's lesson is a review. The test is on Friday.
items.audioZh: 今天的課是複習，考試在星期五。

items.sentenceEn: The scientist has a conversation with the students.
items.sentenceZh: 那位科學家和學生們對談。
很多讀者回覆了我們的調查。

items.stemEn: Before the test, we have a ____ of all the lessons.
items.stemZh: 考試前，我們會複習所有的課。

items.passageEn: Our class did a survey about reading. We asked fifty students. Most of them are big readers, and they love the stories of one writer, Anna Lin. In April, Anna Lin will give a speech at our school. We want to have a conversation with her.
items.passageZh: 我們班做了一個關於閱讀的調查，問了五十個學生。他們大多很愛看書，而且都喜歡作家 Anna Lin 的故事。四月時，Anna Lin 會來我們學校演講。我們想和她聊聊。

questions.questionZh: 四月時 Anna Lin 會做什麼？

items.promptZh: 我們今天有一堂複習課。
referenceEn: We have a review lesson today.
Today we have a review class.
rubricZh: 「複習課」可寫 a review lesson、a review class 等

items.instructionZh: 用 conversation 造一個句子，說說你和誰聊天。
referenceEn: I had a nice conversation with my neighbor today.
I like to have conversations with my friends in English.
rubricZh: 「和某人聊天」可用 have a conversation with（例如 with my neighbor）
時態配合內容（例如今天已發生的事用 had）
